 How GTA 6 release is impacting Xbox and Playstation sales
 Mike Taylor Wednesday 18 November 2026 16:34 GMT 
 Bookmark popover
 Removed from bookmarks
 Close popover I’ve already completed GTA 6 – here’s what you need to know UK retailers including John Lewis and Gumtree have reported a sharp surge in video game console and accessory sales ahead of the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI on 19 November. 
 John Lewis saw a 62 per cent year-on-year rise in hardware sales, while searches on Gumtree for Xbox and PlayStation consoles increased by up to 90 per cent. 
 An estimated 2.8 million UK adults are expected to play the game on its launch day, leading to widespread reports of workers taking time off or faking illness. 
 Some employers are embracing the release, with Japanese developer Pocketpair offering staff up to five days of leave and a US Army battalion offering time off to soldiers who re-enlist. 
 A school in Northern Ireland has warned parents that the release of GTA VI does not constitute a valid reason for pupils to skip lessons.
